notes.title: Hotfix V 1.6.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings blacksmiths,[/b][/h3]

In this hotfix, we addressed a critical bug related to the woodcutting system that was causing major issues in the game. This bug reset all ores collected by workers and led to the game becoming stuck. [i][b]Note:[/b] Players who have encountered the inventory reset issue can manually fix it by cutting their wood stacks into two. This will trigger an internal inventory update and stabilize the system.[/i]

May your blades be ever sharp!

notes.title: Hotfix V 1.6.0
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings blacksmiths,[/b][/h3]

With this hotfix, we are now setting the customer class-based sales system — which we introduced in version 1.6.0 — to be [b]disabled by default[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/5547e0030db3b3f7ee343f808fb30cf31b2dc65e.png[/img]

Our initial goal with this feature was to reward blacksmiths who produce different types of weapons and to provide an incentive for doing so. However, we realized that especially in the early stages of the game, this system proved to be quite challenging. Many of our new — and even some veteran — players expressed dissatisfaction with it. That’s why we are making this feature [b]optional[/b] with this update. With this adjustment, customer purchases will now be determined solely by the sale chance.

We sincerely thank all the players who gave us feedback and alerted us to this issue.

That said, players who do enjoy this more demanding sales system and prefer a game experience that emphasizes management alongside simulation can still enable the feature. Just go to the Settings  menu and activate the [b]Picky Customers [/b]setting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/4c00e814770d1da1d2d9f97d2668caa014fbc333.png[/img]

Alongside this change, we’ve made a few other small tweaks in the game, which you can find below. Thanks again to everyone who reported these issues!

• The “Stop Hammering” label on the assembly desk has been replaced with a more descriptive message.
• Cursor color changed from green to yellow.
• General scene lighting has been improved.
• The cutting area for the large chisel on the lathe has been improved.
• Some localization updates for German, Spanish, and Japanese languages. (Thank you to everyone who reported translation issues!)
• Fixed some lighting issues in the blacksmith shop.

May your hammer stay strong!

notes.title: Medieval Blacksmith Full Release!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Blacksmiths![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/bb4e27465ec4e50a5cba34dbb5e63e901267b427.png[/img]

We’re excited to announce that [i]Medieval Blacksmith [/i]has officially left Early Access and is now in full release!

It’s been almost a year since we launched the very first version of the game. During this time, we’ve met many talented blacksmiths. With your ideas burning bright like a forge, your feedback blowing like bellows, your bug reports sharpening the experience like grindstones, and your powerful critiques striking like hammers — you’ve all contributed to crafting this game step by step. We’re deeply grateful for the inspiration, support, and feedback you’ve given us along the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/648b25d0b5936faca9dadad10ba1685c1747f0d4.png[/img]

To be honest, our initial plan was to create a shorter experience — maybe 7–8 hours. But thanks to your feedback, the world of the game gradually expanded, the systems became deeper, and eventually, [i]Medieval Blacksmith [/i]became something that makes us truly happy — and honestly, it still surprises us how far it's come. We know that without the support, guidance, and inspiration from our players on both our Discord channel and Steam, we wouldn’t have been able to complete this journey. We sincerely thank you once again for all the support you've given us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/36eef2342a86c419f6ad34dea44f787d5649c094.png[/img]

[h3]What’s New in the Full Release?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/08f90e1d7f2820640493bb7887b2d3c1f18ee8de.png[/img]

In this update, we’ve brought the version we stabilized on the Test Branch into the main release.

• Tons of new content, quests, and improvements

• Enhanced user experience

• Performance optimizations

• New weapon parts

• New customer types
    … and much more is now available in the main version!

You can find the full changelog here:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2732100/view/534344758463561750?l=english

[h3]Development Continues (At a Slower Pace)[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/db844964290420e26b1c98732a31b28bbbb43b79.png[/img]

While this is our full release, we don’t see it as the end. Medieval Blacksmith will continue to evolve — just at a slower, more balanced pace. We’re still open to feedback and we’ll continue listening closely.

If you have ideas, feature suggestions, or run into any issues, feel free to reach out. We built this game together — and we can keep shaping it, together.

[h3]And Finally…[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/28ee6f777136377fcbf4e5a9a4557c4f79786c10.gif[/img]

To everyone who’s been a part of this journey — thank you once again. Medieval Blacksmith isn’t just a game to us; it’s a living experience, shaped by its community.

The iron is still hot — and we’re not done hammering.

Until the next hammer falls,

The Medieval Blacksmith Dev Team

notes.content:

We’re thrilled to announce that we’re finally wrapping up the stabilization of the latest update for Medieval Blacksmith that’s been live on the Test Branch. This means we’re just around the corner from pushing this version to the main branch—and with it, Medieval Blacksmith will officially complete its Early Access journey!

Before we move forward, there’s something very important we want to highlight to make sure your progress stays safe.

If you're playing a version [b]older than 1.6.0[/b], [u]your save files will be deleted [/u]when the full version goes live on April 14, 2025. To avoid losing your progress, please switch to the branch named [b]"old_version"[/b].

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your feedback, patience, and support have been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today.

The first change we made to the economy system was adjusting the Low Interest Penalty values for customers. While this value didn’t cause much difficulty in the mid-to-late game, it made early sales significantly harder. This change aims to promote efficient mining while also encouraging blacksmiths to create alloys in their shops.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/bce6819d17c8550eb1f7b670548d6ab5d863b126.gif[/img]

[i]"To access the new version, right-click on Medieval Blacksmith in your Steam library and select Properties. In the window that opens, go to the Betas tab and select the appropriate beta branch to enable the test version."[/i]

[h3][b]Greetings, Blacksmiths...[/b][/h3]

We've updated the game engine to improve compatibility with new devices. To make sure older devices are not affected, this version will be available on the test branch for now.

[i][b]New players can start directly with this version! Plenty of new features, updates, and bug fixes are waiting for you![/b][/i]

If you've played before, please note that [b][u]old save files won't work and will be deleted automatically[/u][/b]. We recommend backing up your save files before switching. This way, you can go back to the previous version if needed.

[b]Your save files are located here:[/b]

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Medieval Blacksmith\Medieval Blacksmith_Data\Resources\SaveFiles

We have temporarily made both the old and new versions available to our players simultaneously in order to prevent potential issues that may arise. This way, if anyone runs into technical issues with the new version, you can still enjoy the game on the old version while we work on fixing things.

We also want to give some extra time to those who are already deep into the game or close to finishing it. Once we're confident that the new version is running smoothly on all devices, we'll move it to the main branch for everyone to enjoy. 

[b]Thanks for your patience and support! [/b]


[h2]SUPPLY AND DEMAND![/h2]
[h3]The Rules of Trade Are Changing![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/08f90e1d7f2820640493bb7887b2d3c1f18ee8de.png[/img]

The art of commerce in your blacksmith shop is evolving! Every customer now has a unique profession, purchasing power, preferred weapon type, and even weapon traits they simply can’t use.

With this new trading system, you'll encounter eight distinct customer classes—each with their own expertise, needs, and budget. Their profession shapes their weapon preferences:

• Rogues favor swift daggers.
• Soldiers demand durable swords.
• Peasants prefer cheap, lightweight weapons they can carry with ease...

Of course, a customer’s weapon preference isn't an unbreakable rule. A rare, masterfully crafted blade can tempt even the most stubborn buyer. But if you’re trying to sell them something outside their usual interests, you'd better give them a good reason—perhaps a little discount might do the trick...

[h3]Know Your Customers, Master the Market![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/b24e45e0f3705f1ed20ce022fec2eb2512f573d3.png[/img]

Every weapon must meet certain minimum requirements based on the profession of its wielder.

• A soldier marching into battle won’t trust a fragile sword that might break mid-fight.
• A mage can’t channel their magic through weapons that aren’t made of pure gold.
• Anti-mages, sworn to fight rogue mages, will refuse any weapon that contains gold.

With all these factors in play, the economy in Medieval Blacksmith is taking on a whole new life! To make quick and steady profits, you’ll need to understand your customers and carefully stock your shelves with weapons tailored to their buying power and preferences.

This new trade system puts the sales strategy entirely in your hands!

💰 Will you mass-produce affordable weapons to attract a broad range of buyers?
🗡️ Or will you craft rare, high-end weapons for a select few, selling less but making hefty profits?

It’s all about supply and demand, and the choice is yours.

And if a customer isn’t satisfied with what’s on your shelves, don’t worry—you can negotiate and take custom orders to meet their needs. Just don’t forget to haggle—after all, a good blacksmith is also a sharp merchant!

[h3]Additional Trade Balancing Updates![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/14d23ca941501946e629ffaee610cc100aeef582.png[/img]

Thanks to your amazing feedback, we’ve made several adjustments to further balance the trade system. We've fine-tuned the prices of certain tools, ores, and items while also addressing a few mechanics that made earning money too easy.

We've also reworked the weapon pricing system to emphasize skill and craftsmanship over raw material costs. [b]Now, factors like cut rate and pierce rate directly impact a weapon’s value[/b]. This means that workmanship is now more important than just expensive materials when determining a weapon's price.

To prevent overpriced, game-breaking profits (like 30,000–40,000 coins), we've stabilized the economy. Our goal was to balance profits to around 1,000 coins per weapon, which we believe is fair when compared to rent, special customer income, and material costs. But of course, we’d love to hear your thoughts!

To prevent repetitive money-making strategies, we've also changed how Nurenor Pass mines work. Ore locations are no longer fixed—every time you enter the mining area, the ore spawns will shift. High-value ores are now rarer, making the mining economy more dynamic and challenging.

These changes aim to break the boring, overpowered strategy of simply mining gold and forging heavy golden weapons for easy cash. However, we haven’t altered the income from special customers, as it's crucial for keeping the story progression smooth.

Balancing updates will now be more frequent, and we’ll keep refining the system based on your feedback! Stay tuned!

[h3]Weapon System Overhaul![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/58e8bd2faeff60bb3d1f096631be258dc410286c.png[/img]
This update brings tons of new weapon parts, including pommel, guard, handle, and blade parts. Plus, thanks to a new blade thickness adjustment feature, you can now craft rapiers, greatswords, and more!

• Blade parts and heavy weapons have been rebalanced, affecting cut rate, pierce rate, and material influence.
• Point of Balance now impacts weapon speed, making weapons with a center of mass closer to the hilt easier to handle.
• You can now thin wooden handles at the assembly desk to craft sleek grips like katana handles (tsuka), enhancing your weapon’s aesthetics.

[h3]Introducing the Ultimate Challenge: GOD CRAFT![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/648b25d0b5936faca9dadad10ba1685c1747f0d4.png[/img]

A new, extremely difficult weapon grade has arrived—one that only the most masterful blacksmiths can achieve: God Craft!

This divine-tier weapon grade is even harder to craft than Legendary, requiring absolute perfection. To reach this level, every single quality stat of the weapon must be at 100%, because a weapon worthy of the gods demands flawless craftsmanship!

[b]🔥 Important Note: Since achieving a true 100% is technically impossible, weapon stats of 99.5% and above will be rounded up to 100%.[/b]

Only the most patient and perfectionist blacksmiths will be able to forge these celestial weapons. Are you up for the challenge?

[h2]UPDATES & IMPROVEMENTS [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/a6f0a7114700f6aec6e878d90b975eb398da4afb.png[/img]

[i]"In this update, we have implemented many new features and improvements that we were excited to see in the game, inspired by the amazing ideas you shared with us. A huge thank you to all our players who supported us with their suggestions on Steam and our Discord channel! You can find the changes we made below."[/i]

• The game engine has been updated for enhanced performance and stability.
• Background working capability has been enabled, allowing for a smoother experience.
• A major shadow optimization has been implemented, contributing to better performance across all systems.

[h3]Blacksmithing :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/c5ac1c4ceda03fa8d0662abcfc47b419f665bfad.png[/img]

• New parts added: pommels, guards, handles, blades, and heavy weapon components.
• Meltable parts: Weapon parts can now be melted down in the smelting bucket.
• Ingot molds are now available to create your own ingots.
• The number of smelting buckets has increased to a maximum of 3.
• A wooden crate has been added for transporting objects.
• The Assembly Desk now allows you to craft thinner (side-flattened) handles.
• A camera shake effect has been added during hammering at the Assembly Desk.
• The negative effect of the first hammer strike exceeding 100% during forging and assembly can now be limited to 98% with skills.
• Ore quality is now displayed on blade bars.
• The heating furnace area has been expanded for better functionality.
• Fuller type now impacts blade bar volume, weight, and price.
• The temperature and contents of the bucket in the smelting furnace are now visible.
• Inventory upgrade skills now increase both ore and wood amounts.
• Auto hammering skill has been enhanced with a new feature—holding Space will continuously hammer as long as it's pressed.
• The appearance of ugly blade tips has been corrected for a cleaner look.

[h3]Mold :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/c897616c1b4f49b2062b2ec75e37725932e3eb63.png[/img]

• Slot names are now clearly displayed.
• The quality value of the molten liquid in the slots is now visible.

[h3]Lathe :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/2b6db7520ccdc4fd05a2a6b69d9646e1b5823cef.png[/img]

• Zoom functionality has been added for better precision.
• Chisels now cut wood more sharply and precisely.
• The reference image is now more prominent for easier guidance.

[h3]Weapon Design Desk :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/ccb1e889c24efba627f922361a45be7738d377e5.png[/img]

• Blade thickening and thinning features have been added.
• Sorting options based on weapon part stats like cut, pierce, and weight have been introduced.
• A new weapon grade has been added for when all values reach 100%—God Craft!
• A mini UI tutorial has been added to the Weapon Design Desk to help new players navigate the complex weapon crafting system.
• You can now assign different ore types to each weapon part.
• The required ore quantity for crafting each weapon is now displayed.
• Outline and description have been added to the flower vase on the desk.
• Heavy weapon addition buttons are now displayed in different colors for clarity.
• Colliders (hitboxes) for the desk have been fixed to prevent items from getting stuck under the table.
• After weapon design approval, changing the fuller type is now locked to maintain consistency.

[h3]Arena & Holy Wars :[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/5cd74ba8d8f5e95f3fa7d66e43a995943389798d.png[/img]

• Arena combat system has been balanced for a smoother experience.
• The effects of armor and rings have been rebalanced.
• An info tab has been added to display the values of armor and rings.
• The free roam key info has been added for easier navigation in the Arena.

[h3]Dialogues :[/h3]

• [b]A separate auto-save slot has been created to prevent soft-lock issues when interacting with Special Customers for the first time.[/b]

• [spoiler]Fixed the issue where embracements (glowing charms) in the final scene wouldn't disappear after speaking[/spoiler].

• Fixed the bug where the saw would launch wood pieces in the wrong direction.
• Fixed the issue of molten metal being visible from the outside in the melting bucket.

And many more minor issues have been resolved...

[h2]THANK YOU![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/a047322d92cb23138ed94e2047ee68b1266dfb42.png[/img]

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks to all the players who have supported us through their feedback, suggestions, ideas, and bug reports, both on Steam and on our official Discord channel!

This update took a bit longer, but combining all of these amazing ideas from you into one package was necessary to complete the early access phase. We hope it was worth the wait! Moving forward, we plan to deliver updates and balancing adjustments more swiftly and get the game ready for its full release.

We also plan to address some fantastic feedback that we couldn't include in this update in the next ones. Thank you again for your endless support. Don’t forget to share any feedback or suggestions you have with us on Steam and Discord!

notes.title: Hotfix V 1.5.1
notes.content:
[b][h3]Greetings, Blacksmiths![/h3][/b]

In this hotfix, we've addressed some issues within the game and made improvements to its difficulty.

[b]Skill Tree Adjustments[/b]

As you know, we introduced the skill tree in the 1.5.0 update. However, based on the feedback we've received from our players, we've decided to make some critical skills much more accessible. Specifically, the reputation required to unlock the Auto Hammering and Molten Heart (Boiling Icon) skills has been reduced from 200 to 75. This means you'll be able to unlock these skills quickly by completing the first quest and crafting a couple of weapons.

[b]Mining[/b]

To provide a faster mining experience, we've reverted the base pickaxe swing speed to match the pre-1.5.0 versions. With the new skill tree abilities, you can now increase this speed even beyond what it was in earlier versions.

[b]Customers[/b]

We’ve also fixed an issue with customer visit frequencies. In versions prior to 1.5.0, customers visited the shop every 60 to 120 seconds, but in the current version, this was mistakenly adjusted to 100 to 200 seconds. With skills, you can now reduce this interval to 50 to 100 seconds for a smoother gameplay experience.

[b][h3]Improvements / Balance Changes[/h3][/b]

• Default pickaxe swing speed has been increased.
• Fixed an issue with customer visit frequency.

We've also adjusted the number of ores slaves can mine per day at level 100:

• Iron: 22
• Copper: 15
• Cila Khanka: 12
• Silver: 7
• Gold: 4

• Additionally, mining silver and gold rocks has been made [b]15% [/b]easier for players. (This will improve significantly with skills!)

• A button has been added to the Weapon Preview Window to hide the UI for a clearer view.

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]

• Resolved UI scaling issues on widescreen displays.
• Fixed a bug in the Save Window where the gameplay time counter would break after exceeding 24 hours.

[h3][b]Thank You![/b][/h3]

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks to all players who have shared their valuable feedback and thoughts about Medieval Blacksmith. If you’d like to share your own feedback, feel free to reach out to us through our official Discord channel or via Steam!

Keep your forge burning hot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/ca09a9813ed129e40e81e206c515e9ec286aef9b.jpg[/img]

Today, we have two exciting announcements for you. First, we're thrilled to share that the demo for Medieval Blacksmith will be available soon! This demo will let you explore the core features of the game and step into the world of the blacksmith. Mark your calendars—on January 1, 2025, the demo will be live!


[h3][b]Update 1.5.0[/b][/h3]

Along with this exciting news, we’re also bringing you the details of our latest update! We’d like to take a moment to thank all our players for their invaluable feedback and bug reports. Your support means the world to us!

[h3][b]New Features[/b][/h3]

[i][b]Skill Tree:[/b][/i]

One of the most requested features by our players was a skill tree and a way we could utilize the professional reputation you’ve earned.

So we’ve combined these elements and introduced a brand-new skill tree system!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/8ec75babb41a893966d88372aeed99183362d22f.png[/img]

Now, the reputation you earn through crafting weapons, completing quests, and interacting in dialogues can be used to enhance your abilities.

With this skill tree, attributes like hammering and sharpening speed can be improved significantly compared to previous versions. Some features that were previously default have also been moved to the skill tree—not to nerf them, but to provide a more satisfying sense of progression. However, if you find this situation boring, please let us know.

notes.title: Update Announcement V 1.4.1
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Blacksmiths![/b][/h3]

In this epic journey where a blacksmith straddles an uncertain past and an unknown future, your hammer will be more than a tool—it will shape the fate of a kingdom. As you craft each weapon, you won’t just forge steel; you’ll carve out destiny itself.

The story of the game is now complete, bringing a journey with multiple endings that allow you to shape the destiny of the kingdom. Every choice you make along the way will ripple through the story, steering it toward unique outcomes based on your actions.

[h3]LATIA ROYAL ARENA NOW OPEN![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/93452820d1fd643a81d9b72ed1c779b9e3d77ee1.gif[/img]

Enter the Royal Arena of Latia, where the strongest warriors battle to the death, and feel the advantage of being a blacksmith. Whether you use your weapon expertise to place clever bets and win riches or equip your slaves with the finest gear to dominate grand tournaments, the arena offers endless opportunities for glory.

Remember, though, that anything that falls upon the arena sands becomes the arena’s property. As their master, keeping your slaves alive is in your hands. Train them, arm them with the best weapons and armor, and prepare them for the brutal challenges ahead. Fail to do so, and you’ll face the bitterness of defeat by losing them to the sands.

[h3]FATES DETERMINED BY COLD STEEL[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/c05ee8910236c35ed4c48f699292b0785c2492e5.gif[/img]

Your fighters’ survival depends not only on their skills but on their gear, fighting styles, and how they work as a team. Will they dodge incoming attacks or block them head-on? Equip a mighty axe for devastating power but at a slower pace, or choose a lighter blade for speed at the risk of breakage in battle. Heavily armored fighters can withstand more damage but may struggle to counterattack.

This complex battle system blends strategy and brute force, where each hammer strike you land will decide whether your fighters stand on the razor-thin edge between life and death. We’ll soon be sharing more details on combat mechanics, damage systems, slave production and growth rates, weapon quality and pricing, the influence of special customers on the storyline, rewards, and more.


[h3]UPDATES AND NEW FEATURES[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/6fad4f189a9713a7f0239ab950bafd2076920d8e.png[/img]

• The multi-ending story is complete.
• Arena battles are now live.
• Holy Wars storyline added.
• Auto-Hammering feature introduced.
• 96 new achievements added.
• 127 new armor pieces and accessories available.
• New battlefields including the Arena, The Hill of the Ancestors, and the Governor’s Chamber.
• Three unique main endings based on player choices.
• New cutscenes and story elements added.
• New marriage option (male blacksmith) and special customers with unique rewards.

[h3]Improvements / Balance Updates:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/3f19436b7ab90ede8f90578988cf807a4cd7b8c5.png[/img]

• Character menu optimized for better functionality.
• New look for slaves.
• Quench quality now impacts weapon guard and durability.
• Added “Smashing” stat to weapon stats.
• Books and posters updated with new content.

notes.title: Update Announcement V 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h3][b]Greetings, Blacksmiths![/b][/h3]

We are thrilled to introduce the new features we've added to expand the boundaries of our blacksmithing craft and to create a wider variety of weapons.

Among the most requested features has been the ability to craft curved swords, as well as axes, maces, and other weapons. With the latest update to Medieval Blacksmith, this is now possible!

[h3]Real Swords Have Curves[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/e5e98cfa4ad544ead9240ccad084172e1573eae2.png[/img]

With this new update, you can now design and create curved weapons, from daggers to spears, using the weapon design table. Adjust the nodes in the curvature window to freely determine the shape, size, and depth of your weapon's curve.

Create and forge katanas, falx, sica, scimitars, yatagans, shamshirs, shotels, and many more! However, remember that while a curve increases sharpness, it decreases piercing ability.

[h3]It's Time to Break Some Bones![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/b89bdb8d7bd62ed40f09015f1e6565ac59112c95.png[/img]

We've added a new class of "Heavy Weapons" to the game. This category includes not only maces and hammers but also axes, halberds, war picks, and war sickles.

In this update, we've included 9 maces, 6 axes, 3 halberds, 2 hammers, and 1 war pick in the heavy weapon category, with plans to add more in the future. If there are any special weapons from different cultures you'd like to see in the game, please let us know through Steam or our Discord channel.

[h3]No, We're Not a "Family" in This Company[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/ba0e3df0fae54678274ce20aac7c05d9324e16dd.png[/img]

With the new worker employment system in Medieval Blacksmith, you no longer have to craft weapons alone.

You can now buy slaves from the slave trader Khumaran to work in your shop. You can order them to produce the weapons you designed or to work directly in the mines. Thanks to medieval ethics, you can do all this without paying them a single copper, disregarding health and safety, and skipping unnecessary pizza parties that would motivate them.

Initially, your slaves' first few weapons may be of poor quality due to their inexperience, but as they work, their skills will improve, allowing them to work faster and produce higher-quality weapons.

[h3]Various QoL Features[/h3]

Based on players feedbacks, we've also added several quality-of-life features in this update. Here are the highlights:

• Weapon Design Save: You can now save and name your weapon designs at the design table, saving you the hassle of recreating them each time. These saved designs will also be useful for production orders given to your slaves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/9fb543db717077baac1b2e69fbbdfcbe002533a6.png[/img]

• Character Menu (Inventory): By pressing the default C key, you'll open the character menu, where you can view all your ores, coal, and uncut wood. This menu also shows your money, reputation, slaves, and usable production buildings. You can assign tasks to your slaves directly from this menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/2d979875617fec01bcbbdbe6910d2b2acca071af.png[/img]

Along with these main features, there are many other improvements and additions:

[h3]Improvements / Balance[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/1b2532b2f58d66dac57456da59f41d24fb71d529.png[/img]

• Weapon Design Desk: You can now select and see the effects of different quench types on weapons.
• Tutorial Scene: Added indicators to show players which tools to select at each stage.
• Tutorial Music: Changes after speaking with "The One."
• Tutorial Dagger Ore: Changed from gold to maradra ore.
• Assembly Desk: If you've held down the hammering too long, you can cancel with the right-click.
• Lathe: Added the ability to fix the height of chisels.
• Music: Added new musics and removed tracks that could cause licensing issues on some platforms.
• Other: Added a small animation for respawning dummies, sound notifications for special customers, key info for using some machines, and fixed some UI responsiveness issues.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44895334/28ee6f777136377fcbf4e5a9a4557c4f79786c10.gif[/img]

• Automatic graphics adjustment at game start to prevent crashes on some devices.
• Fixed the issue where grass density in Nurenor Pass (mining area) wasn't affected by graphics settings.
• Corrected the info bar on the weapon design table from going off-screen.
• Fixed the bug where fast-thrown weapons could pass through walls.
• Resolved the issue where special customers without weapon orders would take your held weapon.
• Corrected grammar errors in some dialogues.

We extend our heartfelt thanks to all the players who provided valuable feedback through our Steam and Discord channels. Seeing the game become more enjoyable as we incorporate your requests brings immense joy to our development team. Your support is truly appreciated.

If you'd like to share your thoughts and suggestions about the game, feel free to reach out to us via Steam or our official Discord channel!

• Various items, including weapon parts, chopped wood pieces, coals in furnaces, and molten ores in smelting buckets, are now saved at the end of each day.

[b]Weapon Pricing[/b]

• Balanced weapon selling prices.
• Balanced ore prices.
• Balanced handle wood prices.
• Balanced handle leather prices.
• Handle leathers and handle length now affect the weapon's selling price.

[b]Smelting Bucket[/b]

• Ores in the smelting bucket are now stacked in different colors. 
• Quality of melted ores in the bucket is now visible.

- Added Reset Option for the mold

• Weapon Design Desk: Corrected some erroneous information in the Blacksmith's Handbook.

• Smelting Bucket: Fixed issue where rapidly taken ore from the smelting bucket would not decrease.

• Mold: Fixed issue where a mold showing 99% filled was displayed as 100%.

• Blacksmith Shop: Improved ground colliders (hitbox).

• Player: Fixed issue where items obtained while running would cause item shake. Removed option to hammer multiple sword parts in Easy difficulty.

• Save System: Fixed bugs related to saving during transition scenes and overwrite save.


We would like to thank all our players who contributed to the development process of Medieval Blacksmith with their valuable feedbacks. If you would like to share your ideas and opinions about Medieval Blacksmithing with us, you can always contact us via our discord channel.

And don't think we've forgotten the other feedback you've given us! We will implement all of these beautiful ideas, one by one, in accordance with the development process.

We hope you enjoy these updates and look forward to your continued support and feedback.

Happy forging blacksmiths!
